metadata.label: Imports and exports of goods by commodity groups SPIN 2007. Volume index 2000=100. (Not updated). Year 2001-2017
note: SPIN 2007 is Statistics Swedens classification of goods. The goods are grouped according to the Swedish industrial classification, SIC 2007 (also called SNI). On 4-digit level SPIN corresponds to Eurostats CPA (Classification of Product by Activity). SPIN is not the same as SIC. While SIC is a classification of enterprises into industries SPIN is a classification of goods into industries. Foreign trade for a certain SPIN-code is therefore not the same as foreign trade for companies with the corresponding SIC-code. SPIN 2002, Prod-SNI 97 and Varu-SNI 69 are all predecessors to SPIN 2007, corresponding to SIC 2002, SIC 92 and SIC 69.

0000026A:
Data on export, import and net trade are revised continuously every month for the last three months. Values are shown in thousands of Swedish krona (SEK) in current prices if nothing else is stated. Weights are shown in metric tons, for some goods other quatities are shown such as cubic meters or pieces. Secrecy in the database is marked with …  
  
For foreign trade with services see [Balance of Payments (BoP)](www.scb.se/FM0001-en). Companies that import and export below a certain threshold within the EU are not obligated to report their trade statistics. These values and values for companies that have not responded are adjusted when adjusted for non-response is stated. Weight is also adjusted in the same way. Data that is not adjusted is based purely on collected values. These values are therefore underestimated.
